method: Existing fixture generators were used only to construct a frozen independent v4 package from the historical 195-record v3 seed. New negative cases were written outside the package and run directly against runtime validators; they are not the pre-existing pytest assertions.

conclusion.independent_negative_recheck: All original malicious payloads reject under updated runtime; last RT-07 source-integrity recheck also rejects.
conclusion.remaining_verification_owner: Implementation agents are completing their combined pytest runs; this runtime reviewer independently ran the preserved CPU probes and read the new source checks.

findings.title: Proposal eligibility trusts contradictory review and validation files without binding their identities
findings.observed: eligible=True accepted despite review_ref for proposal.other with decision=rejected and independent=false, validation_ref status=failed for proposal.other, and target_version=v0003 while base is v0004. Inline control flags were sufficient.
findings.expected: Verify structured review/validation contents against proposal basis hash, proposal ID, exact base knowledge hash, target new version, declared reviewer and independent decision; failed or other-record evidence must reject.
findings.impact: A pending/unreviewed source proposal can be declared eligible with unrelated rejected review files; no automatic graph mutation occurs, but the promotion gate is bypassed.
findings.observed_after_fix: See final-recheck-results.json: old target version rejected; malformed review files rejected by new structured schema; missing frozen bundle/C3/independent review case rejected.

findings.title: A validated_case can contain missing raw results, a different timing request operator and nonexistent selected instances
findings.observed: validate_case accepted evidence_status=validated_case/outcome=accepted even though request operator differs from timing operator, timing request declaration/captures and correctness case refs all point to NONEXISTENT-raw-capture.json, selected_action_instances is [instance.DOES_NOT_EXIST], and no execution/C3 evidence is bound.
findings.expected: Revalidate complete raw timing/correctness evidence and operator/source/workload identities; require selected instance identity and executed C3 binding before upgrading a record to validated_case/case_support; independent review must itself bind the case.
findings.impact: A paper wrapper of invented accepted measurements can become validated_case and later satisfy claim.case_refs case_support.
findings.observed_after_fix: See final-recheck-results.json: old target version rejected; malformed review files rejected by new structured schema; missing frozen bundle/C3/independent review case rejected.

positive_validation.source: implement_diagnosis_runtime agent reported execution; test source independently read by reviewer
coverage: full FakeRunner CPU raw capture/oracle + C1/C2/C3 + implementation/workload identities + frozen routing bundle + independent case review positive
positive_validation.note: This positive fixture is explicitly synthetic and makes no hardware or causal claim.

findings.title: P_KEEP/O_CHANGE accepted implemented with identical parent source and no changed dispatch or parameters
findings.observed_before_fix: Identical parent source hash, identical behavioral dispatch and unchanged parameters passed with one actual_changes line description, yielding implemented/new candidate.
findings.observed_after_fix: Original saved probe rejects with 未发生源码、实际分发或参数变化，不能申报implemented.

findings.title: Double KEEP reported NOOP despite changed actual dispatch when dispatch_domain was in freedom
findings.observed_before_fix: P_KEEP/O_KEEP plus dispatch_domain freedom allowed actual fallback.kernel_entry=changed_despite_NOOP while confirmed plan said paper_kernel; returned NOOP.
findings.observed_after_fix: Original saved probe rejects with 双 KEEP 必须是 NOOP，不能伪造执行或新候选.

findings.title: Numeric parameter enum [1] accepts boolean true
findings.observed: Full C1/C2/C3 chain accepted actual_parameters.tile=true under explicit allowed values=[1]. Python membership conflates True with 1.
findings.expected: Use JSON-aware enum validation that distinguishes booleans from numeric values.
findings.observed_after_fix: Original malicious type values preserved; with new routing config snapshot hash re-bound, validator rejects at parameter freedom or instance identity gate.

findings.title: C2 instance content can disagree with its exact instance_hash through bool/number equality
findings.observed: C1 parameters.tile=1 and C2 selection.instance.parameters.tile=true were treated as identical. selection.instance_hash stayed the hash of the integer-valued C1 instance, although selected C2 instance content hash differed; full chain returned implemented.
findings.expected: Compare exact instance/file/KEEP/plan identity with canonical JSON/hash, and explicitly verify content_hash(selection.instance)==selection.instance_hash. Review all arbitrary-parameter/contract equality sites for the same Python type conflation.
findings.observed_after_fix: Original malicious type values preserved; with new routing config snapshot hash re-bound, validator rejects at parameter freedom or instance identity gate.

findings.title: Frozen P/O bundle replay skips integrity checks of archived source evidence
findings.observed: After modifying one archived P source file exclusively referenced by P/O, load_frozen_bundle still succeeds with unchanged frozen index/config. The declared source sha256 and actual bytes disagree. Live compile would reject this changed source.
findings.safety: Only the copied /tmp source was changed; original bytes were restored in finally.
findings.expected: Verify every frozen P/O record.sources entry against package-local file sha256, valid line interval and excerpt_sha256, without requiring the current live Markdown/REGION metadata to remain identical.
findings.impact: A supposedly provenance-verified historical case or handoff replay can silently accept missing/corrupt archived source evidence.
findings.observed_after_fix: Original /tmp archived-source corruption probe now rejects with 任务证据文件 hash 不匹配 and the exact changed P source path.
findings.fix_review: _validate_frozen_sources is called by common _routing_inputs for every P/O artifact, including explicit artifacts= callers. It checks actual package-local sha256, UTF-8, valid line interval and excerpt hash, while avoiding live Markdown/REGION checks.

verified_boundaries_without_findings: Hard preconditions bind canonical predicates and permit aliases only with matching predicate.
False-valued hard preconditions are preserved; unknown/proxy facts cannot make C3 ready.
Compound registered symptoms require all declared component predicates for known truth values and use false-priority all-of semantics.
Derived evidence dependency cycles and reuse of exact raw hash+locator across independent groups are rejected.
Instance/fact scopes bind task, implementation, workload, complete targets and stage.
Hints accept owner subtree IDs only and cannot carry facts or attributes.
First planning without parent permits P_CHANGE conditional analysis and forbids P_KEEP.
Current diagnosis schema is refused by legacy SPA route and fixed-graph policy training.
C3 reads actual source files, validates line locators and binds confirmed plan file content.
limitations: No NPU/hardware, new training, network or performance experiments were run.

Negative fixture uses the frozen 195-record migration package for runtime gates; the current 200-entry curated catalog was not rebuilt or independently substantively reviewed by this runtime reviewer.
Source semantic equivalence, causal mechanism correctness and real hardware authenticity are beyond these structural validators.
Retrieval refactor and source curation were intentionally excluded because other agents were changing them concurrently.
notes: 7项原始独立负例均已复测拒绝；不以CPU合成采集证明硬件或机制收益。
一次性工作路径不属于包的运行依赖；可复现负例保存在上述包内测试模块。
